prompt: I roll Undertake a Journey and get action die 4, wits 2, adds 0 = action score 6, challenge dice 3 and 8. What happens?

assertions.text: Correctly identifies the result as a weak hit (6 beats 3, not 8)
Calls tick_progress to mark one mark of progress
Calls consume_supply n=1 for the supply cost
Displays the journey track state using circle glyphs (○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●)
